about: The estate's core principles, in ONE place (doc 95, section 8). Every app built from the OS kit carries the core ones automatically and may add others; an edition may say a principle in its own words but cannot drop a core one. Change a principle here and ./securax os check fails until every app is rebuilt with it (./securax os build --all), so a better principle reaches every app. AGENTS.md section 0 holds the same north star for builders.
north_star: The person or team using it is visibly better off: better work, better decisions, a calmer and more purposeful life, risks really reduced. Not paperwork.

principles.name: Ikigai
principles.text: Work where what you love, what you are good at, what you are valued for and what the world needs meet; it keeps you going for years, not weeks.

principles.name: Antifragility
principles.text: Every failure leaves a lesson, a change and a drill, so the next stress finds you stronger.

principles.name: Small wins, shown
principles.text: Progress you can see keeps you going; the app shows it every week.

principles.name: Least effort for you
principles.text: The app does the remembering, the checking and the reminding; you do the one next step.

principles.name: Pareto
principles.text: A few actions carry most of the result. Find them first.

principles.name: Inversion
principles.text: Ask what could ruin it, and remove that downside before chasing upside.

principles.name: Control the inputs
principles.text: You cannot control outcomes. You control decisions, rhythm and follow-through.

principles.name: Compounding
principles.text: A small review kept every week for a year beats a perfect plan kept for a month.

principles.name: Flywheel
principles.text: Each improvement makes the next one easier: visibility earns trust, trust earns support, support builds capability.

principles.name: Never miss twice
principles.text: Missing once is life. Missing twice is the start of a new habit, so the floor is two minutes.
